concepts.rule: LEARNINGS rule 19 — single clean real spacecraft frame, graded, 0-3 words, no composite
concepts.picture: Single striking real spacecraft exposure of sideways Uranus with its vertical rings and bright polar cap filling the frame, graded to high contrast and saturation (no composite, no added foreground objects).
